column1: # RobloxPlayer macOS v0.742.0.7421053 - Luau opcode numbering (verified)
# Three byte-level numberings exist for the 93 Luau opcodes:
#   wire      : (227 * canonical) & 0xFF   -- what the server puts in the bytecode stream
#   vmop      : table_0x1063bb686[wire]    -- byte the interpreter dispatches on
#   1) table_0x10648bb74[vmop] == canonical   (the reverse map baked into the binary)
# AUX column = instruction is 2 words (verified vs CodeGen/src/IrUtils.cpp getOpLength
